Hold the exact linked opening, /workdir/definition.md location, all remaining game text, and actor settings fixed. Asset has 14 words, no title, and no trailing newline. The accompanying candidate deletes only the two remaining own tokens from this shortened asset. File length and semantic content change together; the parent comparison alone cannot identify a unique mechanism. Zero added visible prompt words still incurs all file words/bytes and link markup/target costs.
